about.en: TCOM is the token of TCOM Global, a decentralized IP-governance protocol for licensing and sharing the value of intellectual property, launched with classic manga IP from Osamu Tezuka. It is a BEP-20 on BNB Chain (0xC23db46993f643F1fA0494cd30F9F43505885D84) and is unrelated to Trip.com, whose Nasdaq ticker is also TCOM.
